items.text: Malik Nabers is active for SNF vs Cowboys after murky knee status; up to him post-warmup, practiced full week.
items.why: Full practices; self-decision after warmups; PS elevations were caution
items.implication: Start Nabers; risk of limited/decoy snaps but primary target

items.text: Jeremiyah Love is ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but start him everywhere as Cardinals wouldn't activate if worried about ankle. Confirmed by beat.
items.why: Expected to play all week; active list confirms ankle ok enough for snaps
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside; monitor volume in split
items.opportunity: Rookie RB role expansion possible if limited but primary

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially active today after calf injury and limited practices; expected to play.
items.why: Player said ready; coach cautious but active list clears
items.implication: Start with confidence in Bears offense; full or near role

items.text: Weekend status summary: Love and Odunze expected to play; Kamara not expected; Josh Williams activated (Tucker doubtful); Nabers no news yet (later active).
items.implication: Core for lineup locks; Kamara out boosts Etienne

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL) not expected to play and inactive vs Lions despite late full practice; not quite ready.
items.why: Sources confirm not ready despite participation
items.implication: Sit Kamara; Etienne unchallenged lead back
items.opportunity: Full RB1 workload for Etienne including pass downs

items.text: Watching Zay Flowers (hamstring) among Sunday injuries; later ruled out after big early production.
items.implication: Monitor severity for ROS; short-term WR bump others
items.opportunity: Increased work for remaining BAL WRs

items.text: Ladd McConkey (chest) among key Sunday injuries being watched; did not return in game.
items.implication: Check severity; short-term LAC WR opportunity

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers wherever owned despite risk he could be decoy; active confirmation seals it.
items.why: Active after uncertainty; elite talent even if managed

items.text: Ravens ruled out rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury.
items.implication: No rookie WR snaps; Flowers/others absorb
items.opportunity: Slight bump to Zay Flowers or other BAL WRs

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown high ankle sprain: no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: Confirmed no surgery but multi-week recovery
items.implication: IR candidate; look for NE WR handcuffs/upgrades
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other NE WRs

items.text: Main slate news locked; only major projection change possible is Malik Nabers (Q knee) for SNF. Elevated Berrios/Cambre from PS. Projections live/updating.
items.implication: Monitor for late active/inactive impact on projs
items.opportunity: If out, targets to other Giants WRs

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim Tuesday; Raiders see realistic chance of only missing one game and Week 2 return vs Chargers.
items.implication: Sit W1; stash for potential quick return; Mayer path to targets

items.text: Josh Williams activated; Sean Tucker doubtful. Impacts TB RB committee with Irving/Gainwell.
items.why: Activation and doubtful designation open snaps
items.implication: Irving/Gainwell split elevated; start if needed

items.text: Not a clean start: combine Flowers/McConkey/BTJ/Murray/Okonkwo/Sampson/Lane/Cooper with Bowers (knee), AJ Brown (ankle), Darnold (hip), Stribling (ankle).
items.why: Multiple early exits and pre-game outs

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland after Week 1; preseason loved Bears offense share and that hasn't changed despite any early target competition with Kmet.
items.why: Preseason belief in Bears TE/offense volume intact
items.implication: Hold/buy as TE upside play ROS

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks more real than not after preseason talk; new OC Sean Mannion connection from Packers makes role legitimate.
items.implication: Viable flex/WR3; monitor for sustained targets

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back + contract murkiness); trade possibility remains.
items.implication: Minimal fantasy skill impact; PIT secondary note
